name: adaptive-review
description: Two-mode code review of the current branch's diff. Minimal mode walks the changed code against bundled markdown checklists (git + Read only, no agents, no MCP). Advanced mode adds blast-radius mapping via codegraph/serena, independent reviewer + verifier agents, and browser observation of runtime-class findings via agent-browser. Frontend-first (React/TypeScript/Next.js) with a stack-agnostic core; extend by adding a checklist file, and add per-repo criteria via .claude/review-skills.md. Read-only git.
